India Warns Meta on Content Moderation, Safe Harbour Protections

The Indian government has warned Meta that its "safe harbour" protections are not guaranteed if the company violates Indian laws, particularly concerning child sexual abuse material (CSAM). Discussions focused on the need for greater sensitivity to India's linguistic and cultural context in content moderation, rather than relying solely on global standards. Sources indicated that Meta is increasing its caution regarding such content. The government emphasized that no entity is above the law and that violations of Indian legislation will not be excused.
